app_action_title.description: Manifest: tooltip on the toolbar icon (action.default_title). Brand name, keep as 'PGP Tools' in every locale.

app_cmd_open.description: Manifest: description of the keyboard shortcut that opens the side panel, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_cmd_open_encrypt.message: Open PGP Tools in Encrypt mode
app_cmd_open_encrypt.description: Manifest: keyboard shortcut description, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Opens the panel switched to the Encrypt mode.

app_cmd_open_decrypt.message: Open PGP Tools in Decrypt mode
app_cmd_open_decrypt.description: Manifest: keyboard shortcut description, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Opens the panel switched to the Decrypt mode.

app_cmd_open_sign.message: Open PGP Tools in Sign mode
app_cmd_open_sign.description: Manifest: keyboard shortcut description, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Opens the panel switched to the Sign mode.

app_cmd_open_verify.message: Open PGP Tools in Verify mode
app_cmd_open_verify.description: Manifest: keyboard shortcut description, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Opens the panel switched to the Verify mode.

app_menu_open_in_pgp_tools.description: Right-click context menu item shown when text is selected on a web page. Sends the selection to the side panel. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_tab_main.description: Label of the first tab in the side panel's top tab bar (the workspace where encrypt/decrypt happens). Short: shares a narrow bar with the Keys tab.

app_nav_label.description: aria-label of the side panel's top tab bar (screen readers only).

app_vault_unreadable_title.message: Your vault could not be read.
app_vault_unreadable_title.description: Full-screen error shown after unlock when the stored keys cannot be decrypted. Heading line.

app_vault_unreadable_body.message: Your keys are still stored on this device. Locking and trying again is the first thing to try.
app_vault_unreadable_body.description: Body text under app_vault_unreadable_title when the vault is protected by a password.

app_vault_unreadable_body_passkey.message: Your keys are still stored on this device. Locking and trying again is the first thing to try -- make sure you use the same passkey you set up.
app_vault_unreadable_body_passkey.description: Body text under app_vault_unreadable_title when the vault is protected by a passkey. Same as app_vault_unreadable_body plus the passkey reminder; keep the double hyphen as a dash.

app_vault_lock_retry.description: Button under the vault-unreadable error. Locks the vault so the user can unlock again.

app_import_added_one.description: Success toast after importing keys from outside the Keys tab. $count$ is the number of keys imported (here 1; the English singular does not show the number).

app_import_added_other.description: Success toast after importing keys from outside the Keys tab. $count$ is the number of keys imported.

app_import_view_key_one.description: Action button on the key-added toast; jumps to the Keys tab and highlights the imported key. $count$ is the number of keys (1 here).

app_import_view_key_other.description: Action button on the keys-added toast; jumps to the Keys tab and highlights the imported keys. $count$ is the number of keys.

app_welcome_open_failed.message: Could not open the side panel. Click the PGP Tools icon in your toolbar.
app_welcome_open_failed.description: Welcome page (opened on install): error shown under the start button when the side panel could not be opened. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_welcome_opened.message: Follow the instructions in the side panel to get started
app_welcome_opened.description: Welcome page: large text shown next to an arrow pointing at the side panel once it has opened.

app_welcome_title.description: Welcome page heading shown right after the extension is installed. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_welcome_body.message: Click below to open the side panel and finish setting up your keys. After this, use the PGP Tools icon in the toolbar to re-open it any time.
app_welcome_body.description: Welcome page paragraph under the heading, above the start button. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_welcome_start.description: Welcome page primary button; opens the side panel.

app_welcome_credit_before.description: Welcome page footer, text before the linked brand name 'Am I Being Pwned'. Rendered as: '<before> <link><after>' and the link text is not translated.

app_welcome_credit_after.description: Welcome page footer, punctuation right after the linked brand name 'Am I Being Pwned' (no leading space). Use the locale's sentence terminator or leave empty if none is wanted.

app_onboarding_prf_unsupported.message: Your authenticator does not support PRF. Try a different passkey or use a password instead.
app_onboarding_prf_unsupported.description: Onboarding, protection step: error shown when the passkey the user created cannot derive an encryption key (WebAuthn PRF extension). 'PRF' is a technical name; keep it.

app_onboarding_setup_failed.description: Onboarding, protection step: fallback error shown when setting up the vault protection fails for an unknown reason.

app_onboarding_name_required.description: Onboarding, key creation step: validation error when the Name field is empty.

app_onboarding_generate_failed.description: Onboarding, key creation step: fallback error shown when generating the key fails for an unknown reason.

app_onboarding_intro_body.message: Send private messages that only the right person can read, and verify messages really came from who they claim.
app_onboarding_intro_body.description: Onboarding, first screen: one-sentence pitch under the 'PGP Tools' heading.

app_onboarding_storage_question.message: Where should we store your data?
app_onboarding_storage_question.description: Onboarding, first screen: heading above the storage location picker (this device vs. synced).

app_onboarding_next.description: Onboarding: full-width button that goes to the next step.

app_onboarding_protection_title.description: Onboarding, protection step heading (choose a password or a passkey).

app_onboarding_protection_body.message: Choose how to protect your contacts and keys. You will use this each time you open PGP Tools.
app_onboarding_protection_body.description: Onboarding, protection step: paragraph under the heading. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_onboarding_create_passkey.description: Onboarding, protection step: submit button when the passkey method is selected.

app_onboarding_set_password.description: Onboarding, protection step: submit button when the password method is selected.

app_onboarding_identity_body.message: Create a keypair for encrypting, decrypting, and signing messages.
app_onboarding_identity_body.description: Onboarding, key creation step: paragraph under the heading.

app_onboarding_name_label.description: Onboarding, key creation step: label of the required Name field. The asterisk marks it as required; keep it.

app_onboarding_name_placeholder.description: Onboarding, key creation step: placeholder of the Name field.

app_onboarding_email_label.description: Onboarding, key creation step: label of the email field (followed by app_onboarding_optional in lighter text).

app_onboarding_optional.description: Onboarding, key creation step: lowercase word shown after a field label (Email, Comment) to mark the field as optional.

app_onboarding_email_placeholder.description: Onboarding, key creation step: example address used as the email field placeholder. Use an obviously fake example address.

app_onboarding_comment_label.description: Onboarding, key creation step: label of the optional PGP user ID comment field.

app_onboarding_comment_placeholder.description: Onboarding, key creation step: placeholder of the Comment field, suggesting what a comment might say.

app_onboarding_advanced_options.description: Onboarding, key creation step: small toggle that reveals the algorithm and expiry choices.

app_onboarding_algorithm_label.description: Onboarding, advanced options: label of the key algorithm dropdown (ECC / RSA).

app_onboarding_algo_ecc_hint.message: Modern, fast, small keys. Recommended for most uses.
app_onboarding_algo_ecc_hint.description: Onboarding, advanced options: tiny hint under the algorithm dropdown when ECC is selected.

app_onboarding_algo_rsa_hint.description: Onboarding, advanced options: tiny hint under the algorithm dropdown when RSA is selected.

app_onboarding_expiry_label.description: Onboarding, advanced options: label of the key expiry dropdown.

app_onboarding_expiry_never.description: Onboarding, key expiry dropdown option: the key never expires.

app_onboarding_expiry_years_one.description: Onboarding, key expiry dropdown option. $count$ is the number of years (1, 2 or 3).

app_onboarding_expiry_years_other.description: Onboarding, key expiry dropdown option. $count$ is the number of years (1, 2 or 3).

app_onboarding_create_key.description: Onboarding, key creation step: primary full-width button that generates the key.

app_onboarding_skip.description: Onboarding, key creation step: secondary button that skips creating a key for now.

app_onboarding_passkey_prompt.description: Onboarding, generating step: status text under a spinner while the browser shows its passkey dialog.

app_onboarding_generating.description: Onboarding, generating step: status text under a spinner while the key is being generated.

app_onboarding_rsa_slow.message: RSA keys take a moment to generate
app_onboarding_rsa_slow.description: Onboarding, generating step: small note under the spinner shown only when RSA was chosen.

app_onboarding_preset_title.description: Onboarding, final step heading: choose a bundle of security settings.

app_onboarding_preset_body.message: How careful should PGP Tools be with your keys? Each option shows exactly what it sets, and you can change any of it later in Settings.
app_onboarding_preset_body.description: Onboarding, final step: paragraph under the heading. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name; 'Settings' is the settings tab.

app_onboarding_unlock_with_vault.description: Onboarding, final step: checkbox label (passkey users only). Opening the vault with the passkey also unlocks every key.

app_onboarding_unlock_with_vault_hint.message: The passkey prompt that opens the vault also unlocks your keys. No separate prompt per key. You can change this in Settings.
app_onboarding_unlock_with_vault_hint.description: Onboarding, final step: small explanation under the 'Unlock keys with the vault' checkbox.

app_onboarding_use_preset.description: Onboarding, final step: primary button that applies the selected security preset and finishes onboarding.

app_onboarding_keep_defaults.description: Onboarding, final step: secondary button that finishes onboarding without applying a preset.

app_copy_failed.message: Copy failed - click the extension panel first, then try again.
app_copy_failed.description: Error toast when writing to the clipboard fails because the side panel is not the focused window.

app_copied.description: Success toast after copying to the clipboard. $label$ names what was copied, e.g. 'Public key', 'Fingerprint'.

app_copied_wipe.description: Success toast after copying sensitive material (a private key, a revocation certificate). $label$ names what was copied; $seconds$ is the number of seconds until the clipboard is wiped, followed by the seconds abbreviation.

app_oversized_more.description: Part of app_oversized_files: when more than three files were too large, the first three names ($names$, already comma separated) followed by how many others ($count$).

app_oversized_files_one.message: $files$: file is larger than $limit$ and can't be processed in the panel.
app_oversized_files_one.description: Error shown when a dropped file exceeds the size ceiling. $files$ is the file name; $limit$ is the ceiling, e.g. '4 GB'; $count$ is the number of oversized files (1 here).

app_oversized_files_other.message: $files$: files are larger than $limit$ and can't be processed in the panel.
app_oversized_files_other.description: Error shown when several dropped files exceed the size ceiling. $files$ is the list of file names (comma separated, or app_oversized_more); $limit$ is the ceiling, e.g. '4 GB'; $count$ is the number of oversized files.

app_error_remedy_import_key.description: Button offered next to an error whose fix is importing a key.

app_error_remedy_try_again.description: Button offered next to an error whose fix is retrying the operation.

app_error_remedy_check_key.description: Button offered next to an expired/revoked key error; opens the recipient key so the user can check it.

app_error_key_not_found.message: That key is no longer in your keyring, so nothing was saved. Re-import the key and try again.
app_error_key_not_found.description: User-facing error: an operation referenced a key that has since been deleted from the keyring.

app_error_key_locked.message: This key is locked. Unlock it and try again.
app_error_key_locked.description: User-facing error: the private key needed is still locked.

app_error_vault_locked.message: Your vault is locked, so nothing was changed. Unlock it and run this again.
app_error_vault_locked.description: User-facing error: the encrypted vault (keys and contacts store) is locked so the write was refused.

app_error_weak_password.message: That password is too short. Use at least 8 characters.
app_error_weak_password.description: User-facing error: a chosen password is under the minimum length. The 8 is fixed.

app_error_password_required.message: This key needs its password. Enter the key password to unlock it.
app_error_password_required.description: User-facing error: a password-protected key was used without its password.

app_error_passkey_failed.message: Your passkey didn't complete. Try again, or unlock with a different method.
app_error_passkey_failed.description: User-facing error: the passkey (WebAuthn) ceremony failed.

app_error_passkey_dismissed.message: The passkey prompt was dismissed. Run the operation again when you're ready.
app_error_passkey_dismissed.description: User-facing notice: the user cancelled the browser's passkey prompt. Not a failure.

app_error_wrong_password.message: Wrong password for this key. Check it and try again.
app_error_wrong_password.description: User-facing error: the password entered does not unlock the key.

app_error_symmetric_wrong_password.message: That password didn't open this message. Check it and try again - if you're sure it's right, the message may be damaged.
app_error_symmetric_wrong_password.description: User-facing error: decrypting a password-encrypted (symmetric) message failed.

app_error_ocb_unsupported.message: This message uses an older AEAD (OCB) format this app can't read. Ask the sender to re-send it encrypted normally - any password they choose will work, it's the format that isn't supported.
app_error_ocb_unsupported.description: User-facing error: the message uses GnuPG's pre-standard AEAD (OCB) packet format. 'AEAD (OCB)' is a technical name; keep it.

app_error_no_decryption_key.message: This message is encrypted to a key you don't hold. Import that private key, or ask the sender to encrypt to one of your keys.
app_error_no_decryption_key.description: User-facing error: none of the user's private keys can decrypt this message (the recipient key ID is unknown).

app_error_no_decryption_key_with_id.message: This message is encrypted to a key you don't hold (key ID $key_id$). Import that private key, or ask the sender to encrypt to one of your keys.
app_error_no_decryption_key_with_id.description: User-facing error: none of the user's private keys can decrypt this message. $key_id$ is the hexadecimal ID of the key it was encrypted to.

app_error_not_crx.message: This isn't a Chrome extension package this tool can verify. Choose a CRX3 (.crx) file.
app_error_not_crx.description: User-facing error: the file given for CRX verification is not a Chrome extension package. 'CRX3' and '.crx' are technical names.

app_error_crx_unsigned.message: The CRX signature doesn't match: it wasn't signed by this key, or the file was modified after signing. Get a fresh copy from the publisher.
app_error_crx_unsigned.description: User-facing error: a Chrome extension package (CRX) failed signature verification against the chosen key.

app_error_tampered.message: Signature verification failed - this message may have been tampered with. Don't trust the contents; ask the sender to re-send it.
app_error_tampered.description: User-facing error: the signature on a decrypted message did not verify.

app_error_key_expired.message: A key involved in this operation has expired. Ask the key's owner for an updated key, then import it.
app_error_key_expired.description: User-facing error: a recipient or signer key has passed its expiry date.

app_error_key_revoked.message: A key involved in this operation has been revoked by its owner. Get their replacement key, then import it.
app_error_key_revoked.description: User-facing error: a recipient or signer key carries a revocation.

app_error_weak_algorithm.message: This key uses a signature algorithm that is no longer considered secure. Ask the key's owner to reissue it with SHA-256 or stronger.
app_error_weak_algorithm.description: User-facing error: the key was rejected by the security policy (SHA-1 / MD5 signatures). 'SHA-256' is a technical name.

app_error_corrupted.message: The data is corrupted or was cut off. Get a fresh, complete copy and try again.
app_error_corrupted.description: User-facing error: the PGP data is malformed or truncated.

app_error_not_pgp_data.message: This doesn't look like PGP data. Make sure you pasted the full armored block, including the BEGIN and END lines.
app_error_not_pgp_data.description: User-facing error: the input could not be parsed as PGP at all. 'BEGIN' and 'END' refer to the literal armor header lines.

app_error_storage_full.message: Browser storage is full, so this couldn't be saved. Remove keys or contacts you no longer need, then try again.
app_error_storage_full.description: User-facing error: the browser's extension storage quota is exhausted.
